mapper.sql: select id, space_id, document_name, stable_key, document_version, is_current, file_path, file_size, mime_type, checksum_sha256, rag_document_id, parse_status, chunk_count, token_count, error_message, uploaded_by, ready_time, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, version from kb_document
mapper.insert: insert into kb_document ( space_id, document_name, stable_key, document_version, is_current, file_path, file_size, mime_type, checksum_sha256, rag_document_id, parse_status, chunk_count, token_count, error_message, uploaded_by, ready_time, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, version ) values ( #{spaceId}, #{documentName}, #{stableKey}, #{documentVersion}, #{isCurrent}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{checksumSha256}, #{ragDocumentId}, #{parseStatus}, #{chunkCount}, #{tokenCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{uploadedBy}, #{readyTime}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{version} )
mapper.sql: id, space_id, document_name, stable_key, document_version, is_current, file_path, file_size, mime_type, checksum_sha256, rag_document_id, parse_status, chunk_count, token_count, error_message, uploaded_by, ready_time, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, version
mapper.select: select from kb_document where rag_document_id = #{ragDocumentId} limit 1
select from kb_document where space_id = #{spaceId} and stable_key = #{stableKey} and is_current = 1 limit 1
select ifnull(max(document_version), 0) from kb_document where space_id = #{spaceId} and stable_key = #{stableKey}
mapper.update: update kb_document set is_current = 0 where space_id = #{spaceId} and stable_key = #{stableKey} and is_current = 1
update kb_document set is_current = #{isCurrent} where id = #{id}
update kb_document set parse_status = 'INDEXING', rag_document_id = #{ragDocumentId}, error_message = null, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
update kb_document set parse_status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
update kb_document set parse_status = 'DISABLED', is_current = 0, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
